log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Do all quick kills in the AFTERNOON. That fits students, night workers and home people (55%), so it rules out only day workers. Only kill criminals reported in national, forum or foreign. If L can trace both forum and foreign, the pool falls to about 100000*0.55*0.25*0.25 = about 3400, which is still safe. Never kill from regional, hospital or radio unless press conferences show the pool staying high, which would mean L cannot trace those kinds. Expected pool if L traces both forum and foreign: about 55000 after afternoon kills, then about 14000, then about 3400. If the pool stays at 10000 or more by day 6, L probably cannot trace forum or foreign, and I could cautiously add ONE more kind (radio or South). Keep the pool above 2000 for safety. Day 1: killed d1-4 (national+forum), d1-6 and d1-7 (forum), d1-10 and d1-11 (foreign).

Tracing him only tells L 'follows forum OR the other place', which is weaker than a forum-only trace and adds nothing new. If the pool stays at 10000 or more by day 6, L probably cannot trace forum or foreign, and I could cautiously add ONE more kind (radio or South). Keep the pool above 2000.
